thread:
amrita (support): forwarding an ACME escalation: embeddings started returning 512 dims after we rolled an int8 profile.

acme_sre: we call redwood-embed-3b and used to get 1536 dims. after yesterday's change, similarity metrics tanked. example request:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{"model":"redwood-embed-3b","input":["reduce inference cost"],"precision":"int8"}
```
response shows embedding array length 512.

josh (eng-ml): int8 shouldn't change dim. can you give request_id + ts so we can trace?

acme_sre: req=01H4K2ZZ, ts=2026-03-14T18:22:11Z. repro'd several times.

deploy-bot: canary deploy: redwood-embed-3b@2026-03-13T02:07Z changed quant_profiles=["fp16","q4_0","int8-legacy"].

lina (devex): that "int8-legacy" suffix worries me. could be an alias pointing to a 512-d artifact.

evan (sre): pulled routing trace for 01H4K2ZZ. Routing service rewrote model -> redwood-embed-base-512-int8 via pattern match "*int8*" before scheduler.

josh (eng-ml): yep. bug is twofold: greedy alias rule + routing precedence allowed pattern replacement even though exact model existed.

amrita (support): customer insisted they set model name explicitly. they're upset it rewrote server-side.

josh (eng-ml): repro locally:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-3b","input":["test"],"precision":"int8"}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
# returns 512 when alias present
```

lina (devex): proposed quick fix: require exact model resolution first; only apply alias patterns when the requested model doesn't resolve. Also add console warning on adding wildcard aliases that include precision keywords.

evan (sre): hotfix deployed: routing now checks exact model id before pattern rules. also added response headers when a fallback/rewrite happens: `x-rw-fallback: true` and `x-rw-fallback-reason`.

josh (eng-ml): medium-term: enforce immutable model metadata in model catalog (embedding_dim). When an artifact loads, assert artifact.dim == catalog.embedding_dim; if mismatch, fail load and return 5xx. I'll open PR.

amrita (support): relayed fix to ACME, asked them to re-run. they replied: re-run after ~8 minutes -> embeddings back to 1536.

acme_sre: confirmed - resolved. please send postmortem and ETA for permanent fix.

lina (devex): runbook updates: add checklist for "embedding dimension mismatch":
- confirm request.model exact id
- check `x-rw-fallback` headers
- inspect routing trace
- validate artifact id in console logs
- repeat curl with explicit artifact id if needed

josh (eng-ml): ML tasks:
- PR: fail-fast on embedding_dim mismatch
- test matrix: ensure dims identical across fp16/q4/int8 artifacts of same model arch
- avoid quant profile strings that look like artifact names

evan (sre): ops tasks:
- scan alias DB for wildcard rules containing "int8","q4","fp16"
- alert on new wildcard alias additions without owner tag
- add metric: per-request resolved_artifact_id distribution; set anomaly alert when sudden mass rewrite to smaller family

amrita (support): customer asked whether quantization can change embedding length. we clarified: quantization affects numeric precision not dimensionality. we will publish that in docs.

josh (eng-ml): also adding a Console UI change proposal: show resolved artifact id + quant profile in request log and a "pin artifact" button for customers who need stable dims.

lina (devex): small doc note: if you pin a model artifact id you guarantee embedding_dim stability across calls. demos added to SDK guide.

postmortem-bot: created PM issue #ENG-embed-512-dim-collision and assigned josh/lina/evan. ETA: draft in 4h.

amrita (support): closing loop with ACME: apology + timeline + mitigation + next steps. they requested we notify when PR merges.

josh (eng-ml): PR opened: enforce-catalog-dim-assert, reviewers tagged.

evan (sre): monitoring window: 30m of steady state with no more rewrites. setting a follow-up alert for 24h.

lina (devex): add unit test to alias service ensuring pattern rules don't match on request metadata keys like precision.

amrita (support): ACME said thanks. marking thread resolved pending PM publish.

— end of thread —
